title: Marketing Intelligence AI Engine & Platform
subtitle: Full-Stack React/TypeScript Architecture & Core AI Engine
description: Full-stack development and applied AI implementations at Brand About Me (BAM), a digital marketing company. Architected and integrated the core AI engine powering automated marketing workflows, content intelligence, and platform operations.
longDescription:
At Brand About Me (BAM), an innovative digital marketing company, I work as a Full-Stack & AI Developer during my ongoing LIA (internship). My primary focus is bridging full-stack web development with pragmatic, automated AI systems.

A central responsibility has been designing and building BAM's core AI engine, which powers automated marketing workflows, content intelligence, and smart decision-making across their digital platform.

The system is architected using React and TypeScript, emphasizing clean component boundaries, deterministic type safety, high responsiveness, and seamless integration between user-facing marketing tools and underlying AI models and services.

Key areas of work include architecting modular AI pipeline steps, implementing context evaluation and prompt orchestration, developing responsive operator UIs, and integrating reliable API endpoints for marketing automation.

Note: As this is a private commercial platform, proprietary marketing algorithms, client campaigns, and internal platform features remain confidential.
highlights: Architected and built the core AI engine powering intelligent marketing workflows on the BAM platform
Engineered responsive full-stack features using React and TypeScript for maximum UI performance and type safety
Implemented AI pipeline steps for content synthesis, audience analysis, and brand tone verification
Integrated clean REST endpoints and event-driven data flows between client interfaces and AI services
Collaborated in an agile digital marketing environment to translate strategic marketing goals into software architecture
Maintained strict standards for modularity, clean code practices, and system reliability

title: Internal Enterprise Workflow Platform
subtitle: Reactive Full-Stack Web Platform & Background Automation
description: A full-stack internal enterprise platform built for Devotion Ventures to streamline operational workflows with real-time data synchronization, background job automation, and operator review gates.
longDescription:
Developed as an internal operational platform for Devotion Ventures, this system was engineered to coordinate high-volume data workflows and streamline internal operations.

The application is architected as a modern, reactive full-stack web system using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Convex as the real-time cloud backend. It enables instantaneous state updates across concurrent users without polling latency.

Key architectural capabilities include scheduled background jobs for task synchronization, asynchronous worker queues, automated status monitoring, and human-in-the-loop review gates for sensitive operations.

Note: As this is a private internal enterprise tool, proprietary workflows, internal endpoints, and live dashboards are not publicly accessible.
highlights: Architected reactive cloud backend services and scheduled cron jobs using Convex
Engineered real-time data synchronization and live-updating views for concurrent operators
Implemented asynchronous task pipelines and notification dispatch systems
Built structured operator review gates with approval workflows for sensitive actions
Developed an accessible, high-performance administrative interface in React and TypeScript
Maintained high standards for data privacy, security, and internal operational reliability
